dedupe_keys.name: norwegian hourly residential electricity demand data with consumer characteristics during the european energy crisis

description: Researchers affiliated with Statnett, NTNU and SINTEF publish linked Norwegian household survey and electricity-demand data to study responses to the European energy-price crisis. The survey covers 4,446 consumers and records household characteristics, major appliances, heating arrangements, tariff type and reported changes in consumption. Hourly metering is available for a subset of 1,136 households from October 2020 to March 2022. Aggregate residential demand by Norwegian bidding area spans July 2019 to July 2022, with day-ahead electricity prices also supplied. Zenodo lists six CSV files and offers free downloads under CC BY 4.0. The survey sample and metered subset differ, so model calibration must preserve their linkage and sampling limits. Files were not downloaded or checked for missing observations. The data can support household demand-response simulation and comparisons of price-sensitive load models. They complement the broader electricity time series in data-open-power-system-data; this comparison does not establish a direct integration.
